answer: Farming becomes a shale bet on surviving 93 epochs of grading, and every anchor settlement recomputes the cipher schedule, so an copycat who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 93 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 20 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 36 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
